dedupe_keys.name: monthly urban water and electricity demand for 46 us cities 2007 to 2018

description: This dataset gives monthly per capita water and electricity consumption for major US cities together with pre-processed climate data, to study how climate affects the water-electricity demand nexus. It covers 46 cities with 2018 populations above 250,000 from January 2007 to December 2018, with North American Regional Reanalysis climate data for those cities and 57 climate analog cities that can be used to explore demand under high and low warming without downscaled climate model output. It was assembled by R. Obringer, R. Nateghi, J. Knee, K. Madani and R. Kumar and described in Scientific Data in January 2024. The data are available for download from Zenodo (version 1.0.0, April 2023) under CC0, with one CSV file of utility data per city and 103 text files of climate data, plus the R code used for pre-processing and analysis. Caveats: utility data come from individual providers with differing reporting, and values are monthly city totals, not network-level flows. It supports demand modelling and climate adaptation analysis of water and electricity supply infrastructure and their interdependence; a related record is the ERA5 reanalysis.
